skill.name: souldub-video-translate
skill.description: Translate local MP4 videos through SoulDub with original-voice dubbing and translated or bilingual subtitles.
skill.summary: Run SoulDub video translations, track saved progress, and download dubbed MP4 videos with SRT subtitles.
skill.author: gravityvortex

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown formatting, service identifiers, documented authentication, or expected translation traffic. Confirmed risks include credentials sent to an unrelated fallback host and predictable temporary log paths vulnerable to local symlink attacks. No evidence found of prompt injection or deliberate credential theft in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Generated configuration and the documented example select xxx.com instead of the bundled SoulDub API endpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Use https://api.souldub.ai/api/v1 consistently in defaults, templates, and documentation. Reject unrelated hosts and non-HTTPS URLs before attaching credentials.

remediation.issue: Existing user configuration can retain the unsafe fallback and override the corrected bundled endpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Detect the old xxx.com setting and require endpoint correction before requests. Advise affected users to rotate credentials transmitted to that host.

remediation.issue: Predictable temporary log directories permit precreated symlinks and do not enforce private log permissions.
remediation.suggestion: Use tempfile.mkdtemp with private directory permissions. Create logs exclusively without following symlinks, restrict file permissions, and remove logs when no longer needed.

content.user_title: Translate and Dub MP4 Videos with SoulDub
content.value_statement: Video localization requires coordinated uploads, dubbing tasks, and subtitle downloads. This skill automates SoulDub translation workflows and tracks progress across long-running jobs.
actual_capabilities: Validate local MP4 files, measure duration, and calculate SHA-256 checksums before upload.
Resolve supported source and target languages using registered codes and English or Chinese names.
Upload videos in multipart requests and create SoulDub translation tasks with idempotency keys.
Start translation jobs in the background and save progress for status checks or recent-run listings.
Download translated MP4 videos plus translated and bilingual SRT subtitles.
Retry result downloads from saved state without creating another translation task.
limitations: Requires Python 3.11 or later, uv, network access, a SoulDub API key, and sufficient service credits.
Accepts local MP4 files up to 5 GiB and rounded durations from 1 to 1800 seconds.
Supports registered languages only, rejects automatic target selection, and accepts speaker counts from 0 to 15.
Current defaults can send credentials to an unrelated host; endpoint correction and temporary-log hardening are needed before use.

use_cases.title: Localize educational videos
use_cases.description: Translate recorded lessons and obtain bilingual subtitles for review before distribution.

use_cases.title: Dub product demonstrations
use_cases.description: Create localized product videos while tracking long-running translation jobs.

use_cases.title: Recover translation deliverables
use_cases.description: Find saved client runs and retry result downloads without submitting another billable translation task.

prompt_templates.title: Check readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check authentication readiness and validate Spanish as a target language. Identify endpoint safety problems without uploading a video or exposing credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Translate one video
prompt_templates.prompt: Translate [absolute MP4 path] into Spanish with automatic source detection. Confirm the SoulDub endpoint and upload permission before starting.

prompt_templates.title: Track a background dubbing job
prompt_templates.prompt: Dub [absolute MP4 path] from English into Japanese with two speakers. Verify endpoint safety, start in the background, and report meaningful progress changes.

prompt_templates.title: Recover completed results
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [saved state path] and verify the configured SoulDub endpoint. Retry result downloads without creating a task, then report subtitle and video outcomes separately.

output_examples.input: Translate an approved local MP4 into Spanish after correcting the API endpoint.
output: The completion response also provides the output directory and saved state path.

output_examples.input: Retry downloads for a completed translation when video retrieval fails.
output: Illustrative partial result: Subtitle files were saved, but video retrieval failed after retries.
The existing task remains available through its saved state.
Continue downloading from that state without uploading again.

best_practices: Correct and verify the SoulDub API endpoint before supplying credentials; avoid shared environments until temporary log handling is hardened.
Confirm permission to upload the video and use its speakers' voices before creating a translation task.
Retain the saved state path and review translated subtitles and audio before publishing results.
anti_patterns: Copying the current xxx.com configuration example or placing API keys in prompts and shared logs.
Uploading confidential recordings or using speakers' voices without appropriate permission.
Creating another translation task solely because a completed result download failed.

faq.question: Which video files are supported?
faq.answer: The helper accepts local MP4 files up to 5 GiB. Rounded duration must be between 1 and 1800 seconds.

faq.question: Do I need a SoulDub account and credits?
faq.answer: Yes. You need an API key and sufficient credits. Task creation consumes credits according to the service configuration.

faq.question: Is the current configuration ready to use?
faq.answer: No. Generated configuration can select xxx.com instead of SoulDub. Correct the endpoint before adding credentials, and harden temporary log creation.

faq.question: Can I choose languages by name?
faq.answer: Yes. The helper recognizes registered English and Chinese names or language codes. Source detection can be automatic, but the target must be explicit.

faq.question: What files does a successful job download?
faq.answer: By default, it saves result.mp4, translated.srt, and bilingual.srt. Existing destination names receive numeric suffixes to avoid silent overwrites.

faq.question: Can I recover results after a download failure?
faq.answer: Yes. Continue downloading with the saved state file. The helper refreshes temporary media URLs without creating another translation task.
